description: We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control

description:

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated and compassionate Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical PRN role offers the flexibility to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being. You will be an essential part of a multidisciplinary team, providing high-quality speech and language therapy services to residents.

This is a critical opening, and we are looking for a professional ready to contribute immediately. Enjoy the flexibility of a PRN schedule while making a vital difference in the lives of patients. We offer competitive compensation and a supportive environment focused on patient-centered care.

Take advantage of a generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus, reflecting our commitment to attracting top talent. If you are a skilled SLP looking for a rewarding PRN opportunity with excellent incentives, we encourage you to apply today.
requirements: Current state licensure as a Speech Language Pathologist (SLP)
Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC-SLP) from ASHA
Previous experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work on a PRN basis
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38 - $49 per hour, plus a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.

description: Are you a dedicated Physical Therapist Assistant looking for a flexible PRN opportunity? A premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL, is seeking a compassionate and skilled Physical Therapist Assistant to join their therapy team. This role offers the chance to make a significant impact on patients' recovery journeys, providing essential rehabilitation services on an as-needed basis.In this PRN position, you will work collaboratively with a multidisciplinary team to implement individualized treatment plans, helping patients regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall quality of life. This is an excellent opportunity for a PTA seeking flexibility while contributing to a supportive and patient-focused environment.
requirements: Current and valid Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in Florida
Associate's degree from an accredited PTA program
Minimum of 1 year of experience as a PTA, preferably in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation for PTA is $28.00 - $37.00 per hour.
